items.title: Frank Tate interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clearwater Beach, Florida, March 17, 2001
items.q: It was a record with Slam Stewart and Everett Barksdale.

ctx.x: Yeah. It was a record with Slam Stewart and Everett Barksdale. And it was a ten inch LP and I had it stolen in the 70s when I had a whole footlocker — my prize possessions gone.
